plan.scene: Storm surge / coastal flooding with foamy seawater inundating a low-lying palm-fringed settlement. Tall coconut palms standing in floodwater, single-storey coastal houses with red clay tiled roofs and white/plaster walls on right and left, black rock rubble seawall / groyne (pulimuttu) in background being overtopped by large white breaking waves, overcast dark grey storm sky. Ground completely covered in murky seawater flowing inland. No vehicles, no clear people, no emergency services visible. No readable signs. Low resolution mobile video, no obvious watermark/logo. Vegetation tropical, architecture typical of southwest India coastal village. Weather is stormy/monsoon-like, daytime but dark clouds.
plan.guess_location: Southwest coast of India, likely Kerala (Chellanam / Kochi / Alappuzha coastal belt) - not Gujarat/Maharashtra Tauktae landfall zone
